items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands GPT-6 and Intelligent UI to ChatGPT Free and Go
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 將 GPT-6 與智慧介面擴至 ChatGPT 免費與 Go
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 7 it is bringing GPT-6 to ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, so answers can mix text, charts, diagrams, buttons, forms, and in-chat tools, and can start before thinking finishes. Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise began on Oct. 7 with GPT-6 Sol; Free and Go expand on Oct. 8 with GPT-6 Luna. Pro reasoning still uses GPT-6 Astra without Intelligent UI, and Work and Codex models are unchanged.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 7 日宣布把 GPT-6 與 Intelligent UI 帶進 ChatGPT，回答可混合文字、圖表、按鈕、表單與對話內工具，並可在思考結束前先開始作答。Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 於 7 日以 GPT-6 Sol 開始；免費與 Go 於 8 日改用 GPT-6 Luna。Pro 推理仍用 GPT-6 Astra 且不支援智慧介面，Work 與 Codex 模型不變。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product rollout of existing GPT-6 tiers, not a new flagship name: the change is interactive answers and earlier partial responses for the weekly ChatGPT base. Safety claims are OpenAI’s own adversarial tests versus GPT-5.6 Sol, and the 44% faster search start is an internal timing metric, not an independent quality study.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是既有 GPT-6 分層的產品推廣，不是新旗艦名稱；改變在互動式回答與更早的部分回覆。安全宣稱來自 OpenAI 相對 GPT-5.6 Sol 的對抗測試，搜尋提早 44% 也是內部計時，不是獨立品質研究。
items_flat.quote: GPT‑6 with Intelligent UI starts rolling out globally to ChatGPT Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers today in the Chat tab. Starting tomorrow, the rollout expands to Free and Go tiers.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 與 Intelligent UI 今日起在 Chat 分頁向全球 Plus、Pro、Business 與 Enterprise 推出。明日起擴及免費與 Go。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5 and cuts Sonnet cache-read prices
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，並調降 Sonnet 快取讀取價
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic on Oct. 7 introduced Claude Haiku 5.5, calling it its cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model, aimed at high-volume work and as a subagent beside Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5. For prompts up to 100k tokens it costs $0.10 / $0.50 per million input/output tokens, about 90% below Haiku 4.5 in that band. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads fell from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月 7 日推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，稱其為最便宜、最快、能力最強的小型模型，面向高量工作，並可作為 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 的子代理。10 萬 token 以內提示的輸入／輸出為每百萬 $0.10／$0.50，該區間約比 Haiku 4.5 低 90%。Sonnet 5.5 快取讀取由每百萬 $0.20 降至 $0.10。
items_flat.analysis_en: The pricing move matters more than the small-model label: Anthropic is pushing volume work onto Haiku while making Sonnet agent loops cheaper. Its benchmark edges over GPT-6 Luna are Anthropic’s own tables, and migration risk is real because manual extended thinking now returns a 400 error.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 定價比「小模型」標籤更關鍵：Anthropic 把高量工作推向 Haiku，並讓 Sonnet 代理迴圈更便宜。對 GPT-6 Luna 的領先來自自家表格；手動延伸思考會回 400，遷移風險真實存在。
items_flat.quote: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we’ve ever released.
items_flat.quote_zh: 介紹 Claude Haiku 5.5：我們發布過最便宜、最快、能力最強的小型模型。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI publishes math results from an unreleased internal model
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 公開未發布內部模型的數學成果
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 6 it is releasing a broad set of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model, published on GitHub with revision and citation protocols and Lean formalizations of many proofs. It said the average result is not a public model launch and that unreleased capability is being held back.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 6 日表示，正公開內部前沿模型產出的一批新數學結果，放在 GitHub，並附修訂與引用規範，以及多則證明的 Lean 形式化。這是成果披露，不是公開模型發布，未釋出能力仍被保留。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a disclosure of results, not a model launch: verification still depends on Lean coverage and community review, and OpenAI itself says unreleased capability is being held back.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是成果披露，不是模型發布：驗證仍取決於 Lean 覆蓋與社群審查，OpenAI 自己也說未釋出能力仍被保留。
items_flat.quote: We’re releasing a broad range of new mathematical results produced by an internal frontier model.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在發布一套由內部前沿模型產出的新數學結果。

items_flat.title_en: Broadcom in early talks on $50B-plus financing for OpenAI custom chips
items_flat.title_zh: 博通據報正談逾 500 億美元融資，供 OpenAI 自研晶片
items_flat.summary_en: Bloomberg and the Wall Street Journal reported on Oct. 7 that Broadcom has held early discussions to arrange more than $50 billion in financing so OpenAI can buy the custom AI chip the two are developing together. Apollo and Blackstone were named among lenders spoken to. The same reports said the talks are early and the size could still change.
items_flat.summary_zh: 彭博與《華爾街日報》於 10 月 7 日報導，博通已就安排逾 500 億美元融資進行初期討論，供 OpenAI 購買雙方共同開發的自研 AI 晶片。Apollo 與 Blackstone 被點名為接觸過的貸方。報導稱談判仍早，規模仍可能變動。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is sourced to people familiar with the talks, not an OpenAI or Broadcom announcement, so it is not a closed financing. If it proceeds, it would shift more of OpenAI’s compute bet onto a custom Broadcom part and private credit rather than only merchant GPUs.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 消息來自知情人士，不是 OpenAI 或博通公告，因此不是已敲定的融資。若成真，OpenAI 的算力押注會更偏向博通自研晶片與私募債信，而非只靠商用 GPU。

items_flat.title_en: Biohub, DOE, NIH, DeepMind, and Meta commit $1.8B to AI-ready biology data
items_flat.title_zh: Biohub、能源部、NIH、DeepMind 與 Meta 投入 18 億美元建 AI 生物資料
items_flat.summary_en: Biohub said on Oct. 7 that it, the U.S. Department of Energy, NIH, and new partners are putting $1.8 billion into funding, data, compute, and measurement tech for open datasets meant to train predictive biology models. Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and Meta are collectively investing $300 million; DOE pledged more than $500 million over five years. A virtual-cell model within five years is stated as a goal.
items_flat.summary_zh: Biohub 於 10 月 7 日表示，與美國能源部、NIH 及新夥伴投入 18 億美元，用於資金、資料、算力與量測技術，以建立可訓練預測生物模型的開放資料集。Google DeepMind、Isomorphic Labs 與 Meta 合計投資 3 億美元；能源部五年承諾逾 5 億美元。五年內出現虛擬細胞模型被列為目標。
items_flat.analysis_en: The useful output is data, not a model launch, and openness is sequenced rather than immediate. Whether a virtual-cell model appears inside five years is a goal, not a delivered system.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 有用產出是資料，不是模型發布，開放也是分期而非即時。五年內是否出現虛擬細胞模型是目標，不是已交付系統。
items_flat.quote: Together, the organizations are investing $1.8 billion in funding, data, computation, and new measurement technology, the largest coordinated commitment to generating AI-ready biological data to date.
items_flat.quote_zh: 各組織合計投入 18 億美元於資金、資料、運算與新量測技術，是迄今產生 AI 可用生物資料最大規模的協調承諾。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral opens a public preview of Mistral Large 4, ‘Le Chonk’
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 公開預覽 Mistral Large 4「Le Chonk」
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4 on Oct. 6: a natively multimodal model with 1 trillion parameters and about 49–52 billion active, trained from scratch on roughly 3,800–4,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in its European data centers. Weights are not out; the company has said an open-weight drop is planned later in October.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 於 10 月 6 日公開預覽 Mistral Large 4：原生多模態、1 兆參數、約 490–520 億活躍參數，在歐洲資料中心約 3,800–4,000 顆 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 上從零訓練。權重尚未放出，公司稱計畫 10 月稍後開放。
items_flat.analysis_en: The sovereignty pitch is concrete—European training and a promised open-weight drop—but the weights are not out, and several headline cyber scores reflect company-supplied evals rather than a settled independent ranking.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 主權論點具體：歐洲訓練與承諾的開放權重。但權重尚未釋出，多項資安分數來自公司提供的評測，不是已定案的獨立排名。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re launching a public preview of Mistral Large 4.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Mistral Large 4 的公開預覽。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 把網路驗證計畫擴成三級
items_flat.summary_en: On Oct. 6 Anthropic launched an expanded Cyber Verification Program that gives qualifying security professionals advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers. The program now has three access tiers and includes Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Mythos 5.1. Access still depends on verification, scope, and security controls.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月 6 日推出擴充版網路驗證計畫，讓合格資安人員取得進階網路能力並降低阻擋分類器。計畫現分三級，涵蓋 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 與 Mythos 5.1。存取仍取決於驗證、範圍與安全控制。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is gated defender access, not a public jailbreak of safeguards. The practical effect depends on who qualifies and how often reduced classifiers still block legitimate testing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是有門檻的防禦者存取，不是公開拆除防護。實際效果取決於誰能通過，以及降低後的分類器仍多常擋住合法測試。
items_flat.quote: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program, which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出擴充版網路驗證計畫，讓符合資格的安全專業人員使用進階網路能力與降低後的阻擋分類器。

items_flat.title_en: Google opens SynthID Detector to everyone
items_flat.title_zh: Google 向所有人開放 SynthID Detector
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind said on Oct. 7 that SynthID Detector is now available globally in English, expanding a tool previously aimed at media professionals. Users can check image, video, or audio for SynthID watermarks from Google and partners including OpenAI, NVIDIA, Kakao, and soon Apple. Google said it has watermarked over 180 billion images and videos.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 10 月 7 日表示，SynthID Detector 現以英文全球開放，從原先面向媒體專業人士擴及一般使用者。可檢查影像、影片或音訊是否含 Google 及 OpenAI、NVIDIA、Kakao、即將加入的 Apple 等夥伴的 SynthID 浮水印。Google 稱已為逾 1,800 億張影像與影片加上浮水印。
items_flat.analysis_en: Public detection only works on content that participating labs actually watermarked, so absence of a mark is not proof of human authorship. Cross-lab coverage is the useful change; language and partner gaps remain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 公開偵測只對參與實驗室實際加上浮水印的內容有效，沒有標記不代表是人類創作。跨實驗室覆蓋才是有用變化；語言與夥伴缺口仍在。
items_flat.quote: Now, we’re expanding access to everyone – with the tool available globally in English starting today.
items_flat.quote_zh: 現在我們把存取擴及所有人——工具即日起以英文全球提供。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI previews College Planner inside ChatGPT for Teens
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 ChatGPT 青少年版的大學規劃工具
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI on Oct. 7 shared progress on ChatGPT for Teens, the default experience for accounts identified as under 18, and previewed College Planner for U.S. high-school students planning a four-year college. It said protections are on by default and that College Planner, which gathers requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial-aid steps, is coming soon.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 7 日分享 ChatGPT 青少年版進展，這是被識別為 18 歲以下帳號的預設體驗，並預覽給美國高中生規劃四年制大學的 College Planner。保護預設開啟；彙整申請條件、截止日、任務與助學步驟的規劃工具即將推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: The usage figures OpenAI has cited are its own comparison, not an independent study of learning outcomes. The product change that matters is a U.S.-only planning surface still listed as coming soon.
items_flat.analysis_zh: OpenAI 引用的使用數字是自家比較，不是學習成效的獨立研究。真正的產品變化是仍標為即將推出、且僅限美國的規劃介面。
items_flat.quote: Coming soon: College Planner brings application requirements, deadlines, tasks and financial-aid steps together for high school students in the U.S. planning to attend a four-year college.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即將推出：College Planner 為計畫就讀美國四年制大學的高中生，集中申請條件、截止日、任務與助學步驟。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Compliance API starts returning unified Claude chats
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 合規 API 開始回傳統一 Claude 對話
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic’s docs on Oct. 8 said Compliance API chat endpoints now also return chats from the unified Claude experience, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations, using the existing Compliance Access Key. The change is a records-access expansion, not a new model.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 文件於 10 月 8 日寫道，合規 API 的對話端點現也回傳統一 Claude 體驗中的對話，對 Claude Enterprise 組織為測試版，沿用既有合規存取金鑰。這是紀錄存取擴充，不是新模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: Enterprise retention and e-discovery coverage is the practical change. It is still beta, and it does not say whether every surface or retention setting is included.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 實務變化是企業留存與電子搜索覆蓋。目前仍是測試版，文件未說明是否涵蓋每個介面或留存設定。
items_flat.quote: The Compliance API chat endpoints now also return chats from the unified Claude experience, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations, with your existing Compliance Access Key.
items_flat.quote_zh: 合規 API 對話端點現也回傳統一 Claude 體驗中的對話，對 Claude Enterprise 組織為測試版，使用既有合規存取金鑰。

items_flat.title_en: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2 as an open multimodal embedder
items_flat.title_zh: Google 發布開放多模態嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2
items_flat.summary_en: Google on Oct. 6 launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open model under Apache 2.0, built on the Gemma 4 architecture. It maps text, code, images, video, and audio into one embedding space for on-device retrieval. Google said it leads its size class.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 於 10 月 6 日推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，7.4 億參數、Apache 2.0、基於 Gemma 4 架構。它把文字、程式、影像、影片與音訊映射到同一嵌入空間，供裝置端檢索。Google 稱其領先同尺寸級。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a small open embedder, not a frontier chat model. Its value is local multimodal search; the size-class leader claim is Google’s, not an independent leaderboard result.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是小型開放嵌入模型，不是前沿對話模型。價值在本地多模態搜尋；同級領先是 Google 的說法，不是獨立排行榜結果。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re launching EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding beyond text to unify code, images, video, and audio in a shared embedding space.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，從文字擴展到在同一嵌入空間整合程式碼、影像、影片與音訊。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI details computer-use research with Ironclad
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 說明與 Ironclad 的電腦使用研究
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 6 that a research collaboration with contracting firm Ironclad is being used to train and evaluate agents on professional computer-use tasks. It said GPT-6 Astra is the first frontier model trained on those tasks. The reported scores are an internal research eval.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 6 日表示，與合約公司 Ironclad 的研究合作用於訓練並評估代理在專業電腦使用任務上的表現。它稱 GPT-6 Astra 是第一個在這些任務上訓練的前沿模型。公布分數為內部研究評測。
items_flat.analysis_en: The numbers are an internal research eval, not a public benchmark. They show OpenAI treating contract workflows as training signal for computer use, not a new product launch.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 數字是內部研究評測，不是公開基準。它顯示 OpenAI 把合約流程當電腦使用的訓練訊號，不是新產品發布。
items_flat.quote: GPT‑6 Astra is our first frontier model trained on Ironclad tasks.
items_flat.quote_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是我們第一個在 Ironclad 任務上訓練的前沿模型。

openai.title_en: OpenAI previews College Planner inside ChatGPT for Teens
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 預覽 ChatGPT 青少年版的大學規劃工具
openai.summary_en: OpenAI on Oct. 7 shared progress on ChatGPT for Teens, the default experience for accounts identified as under 18, and previewed College Planner for U.S. high-school students planning a four-year college. It said protections are on by default and that College Planner, which gathers requirements, deadlines, tasks, and financial-aid steps, is coming soon.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 7 日分享 ChatGPT 青少年版進展，這是被識別為 18 歲以下帳號的預設體驗，並預覽給美國高中生規劃四年制大學的 College Planner。保護預設開啟；彙整申請條件、截止日、任務與助學步驟的規劃工具即將推出。
openai.analysis_en: The usage figures OpenAI has cited are its own comparison, not an independent study of learning outcomes. The product change that matters is a U.S.-only planning surface still listed as coming soon.
openai.analysis_zh: OpenAI 引用的使用數字是自家比較，不是學習成效的獨立研究。真正的產品變化是仍標為即將推出、且僅限美國的規劃介面。
openai.quote: Coming soon: College Planner brings application requirements, deadlines, tasks and financial-aid steps together for high school students in the U.S. planning to attend a four-year college.
openai.quote_zh: 即將推出：College Planner 為計畫就讀美國四年制大學的高中生，集中申請條件、截止日、任務與助學步驟。

openai.title_en: OpenAI details computer-use research with Ironclad
openai.title_zh: OpenAI 說明與 Ironclad 的電腦使用研究
openai.summary_en: OpenAI said on Oct. 6 that a research collaboration with contracting firm Ironclad is being used to train and evaluate agents on professional computer-use tasks. It said GPT-6 Astra is the first frontier model trained on those tasks. The reported scores are an internal research eval.
openai.summary_zh: OpenAI 於 10 月 6 日表示，與合約公司 Ironclad 的研究合作用於訓練並評估代理在專業電腦使用任務上的表現。它稱 GPT-6 Astra 是第一個在這些任務上訓練的前沿模型。公布分數為內部研究評測。
openai.analysis_en: The numbers are an internal research eval, not a public benchmark. They show OpenAI treating contract workflows as training signal for computer use, not a new product launch.
openai.analysis_zh: 數字是內部研究評測，不是公開基準。它顯示 OpenAI 把合約流程當電腦使用的訓練訊號，不是新產品發布。
openai.quote: GPT‑6 Astra is our first frontier model trained on Ironclad tasks.
openai.quote_zh: GPT-6 Astra 是我們第一個在 Ironclad 任務上訓練的前沿模型。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5 and cuts Sonnet cache-read prices
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，並調降 Sonnet 快取讀取價
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic on Oct. 7 introduced Claude Haiku 5.5, calling it its cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model, aimed at high-volume work and as a subagent beside Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5. For prompts up to 100k tokens it costs $0.10 / $0.50 per million input/output tokens, about 90% below Haiku 4.5 in that band. Sonnet 5.5 cache reads fell from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月 7 日推出 Claude Haiku 5.5，稱其為最便宜、最快、能力最強的小型模型，面向高量工作，並可作為 Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 的子代理。10 萬 token 以內提示的輸入／輸出為每百萬 $0.10／$0.50，該區間約比 Haiku 4.5 低 90%。Sonnet 5.5 快取讀取由每百萬 $0.20 降至 $0.10。
anthropic.analysis_en: The pricing move matters more than the small-model label: Anthropic is pushing volume work onto Haiku while making Sonnet agent loops cheaper. Its benchmark edges over GPT-6 Luna are Anthropic’s own tables, and migration risk is real because manual extended thinking now returns a 400 error.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 定價比「小模型」標籤更關鍵：Anthropic 把高量工作推向 Haiku，並讓 Sonnet 代理迴圈更便宜。對 GPT-6 Luna 的領先來自自家表格；手動延伸思考會回 400，遷移風險真實存在。
anthropic.quote: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5: the cheapest, fastest, and most capable small model we’ve ever released.
anthropic.quote_zh: 介紹 Claude Haiku 5.5：我們發布過最便宜、最快、能力最強的小型模型。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic expands its Cyber Verification Program into three tiers
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 把網路驗證計畫擴成三級
anthropic.summary_en: On Oct. 6 Anthropic launched an expanded Cyber Verification Program that gives qualifying security professionals advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers. The program now has three access tiers and includes Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Mythos 5.1. Access still depends on verification, scope, and security controls.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 於 10 月 6 日推出擴充版網路驗證計畫，讓合格資安人員取得進階網路能力並降低阻擋分類器。計畫現分三級，涵蓋 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 與 Mythos 5.1。存取仍取決於驗證、範圍與安全控制。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is gated defender access, not a public jailbreak of safeguards. The practical effect depends on who qualifies and how often reduced classifiers still block legitimate testing.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是有門檻的防禦者存取，不是公開拆除防護。實際效果取決於誰能通過，以及降低後的分類器仍多常擋住合法測試。
anthropic.quote: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program, which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們推出擴充版網路驗證計畫，讓符合資格的安全專業人員使用進階網路能力與降低後的阻擋分類器。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic Compliance API starts returning unified Claude chats
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 合規 API 開始回傳統一 Claude 對話
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic’s docs on Oct. 8 said Compliance API chat endpoints now also return chats from the unified Claude experience, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations, using the existing Compliance Access Key. The change is a records-access expansion, not a new model.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 文件於 10 月 8 日寫道，合規 API 的對話端點現也回傳統一 Claude 體驗中的對話，對 Claude Enterprise 組織為測試版，沿用既有合規存取金鑰。這是紀錄存取擴充，不是新模型。
anthropic.analysis_en: Enterprise retention and e-discovery coverage is the practical change. It is still beta, and it does not say whether every surface or retention setting is included.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 實務變化是企業留存與電子搜索覆蓋。目前仍是測試版，文件未說明是否涵蓋每個介面或留存設定。
anthropic.quote: The Compliance API chat endpoints now also return chats from the unified Claude experience, in beta for Claude Enterprise organizations, with your existing Compliance Access Key.
anthropic.quote_zh: 合規 API 對話端點現也回傳統一 Claude 體驗中的對話，對 Claude Enterprise 組織為測試版，使用既有合規存取金鑰。

google.title_en: Google opens SynthID Detector to everyone
google.title_zh: Google 向所有人開放 SynthID Detector
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind said on Oct. 7 that SynthID Detector is now available globally in English, expanding a tool previously aimed at media professionals. Users can check image, video, or audio for SynthID watermarks from Google and partners including OpenAI, NVIDIA, Kakao, and soon Apple. Google said it has watermarked over 180 billion images and videos.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 10 月 7 日表示，SynthID Detector 現以英文全球開放，從原先面向媒體專業人士擴及一般使用者。可檢查影像、影片或音訊是否含 Google 及 OpenAI、NVIDIA、Kakao、即將加入的 Apple 等夥伴的 SynthID 浮水印。Google 稱已為逾 1,800 億張影像與影片加上浮水印。
google.analysis_en: Public detection only works on content that participating labs actually watermarked, so absence of a mark is not proof of human authorship. Cross-lab coverage is the useful change; language and partner gaps remain.
google.analysis_zh: 公開偵測只對參與實驗室實際加上浮水印的內容有效，沒有標記不代表是人類創作。跨實驗室覆蓋才是有用變化；語言與夥伴缺口仍在。
google.quote: Now, we’re expanding access to everyone – with the tool available globally in English starting today.
google.quote_zh: 現在我們把存取擴及所有人——工具即日起以英文全球提供。

google.title_en: Google releases EmbeddingGemma 2 as an open multimodal embedder
google.title_zh: Google 發布開放多模態嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2
google.summary_en: Google on Oct. 6 launched EmbeddingGemma 2, a 740-million-parameter open model under Apache 2.0, built on the Gemma 4 architecture. It maps text, code, images, video, and audio into one embedding space for on-device retrieval. Google said it leads its size class.
google.summary_zh: Google 於 10 月 6 日推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，7.4 億參數、Apache 2.0、基於 Gemma 4 架構。它把文字、程式、影像、影片與音訊映射到同一嵌入空間，供裝置端檢索。Google 稱其領先同尺寸級。
google.analysis_en: This is a small open embedder, not a frontier chat model. Its value is local multimodal search; the size-class leader claim is Google’s, not an independent leaderboard result.
google.analysis_zh: 這是小型開放嵌入模型，不是前沿對話模型。價值在本地多模態搜尋；同級領先是 Google 的說法，不是獨立排行榜結果。
google.quote: Today, we’re launching EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding beyond text to unify code, images, video, and audio in a shared embedding space.
google.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 EmbeddingGemma 2，從文字擴展到在同一嵌入空間整合程式碼、影像、影片與音訊。

frontier_other.title_en: Biohub, DOE, NIH, DeepMind, and Meta commit $1.8B to AI-ready biology data
frontier_other.title_zh: Biohub、能源部、NIH、DeepMind 與 Meta 投入 18 億美元建 AI 生物資料
frontier_other.summary_en: Biohub said on Oct. 7 that it, the U.S. Department of Energy, NIH, and new partners are putting $1.8 billion into funding, data, compute, and measurement tech for open datasets meant to train predictive biology models. Google DeepMind, Isomorphic Labs, and Meta are collectively investing $300 million; DOE pledged more than $500 million over five years. A virtual-cell model within five years is stated as a goal.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Biohub 於 10 月 7 日表示，與美國能源部、NIH 及新夥伴投入 18 億美元，用於資金、資料、算力與量測技術，以建立可訓練預測生物模型的開放資料集。Google DeepMind、Isomorphic Labs 與 Meta 合計投資 3 億美元；能源部五年承諾逾 5 億美元。五年內出現虛擬細胞模型被列為目標。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The useful output is data, not a model launch, and openness is sequenced rather than immediate. Whether a virtual-cell model appears inside five years is a goal, not a delivered system.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 有用產出是資料，不是模型發布，開放也是分期而非即時。五年內是否出現虛擬細胞模型是目標，不是已交付系統。
frontier_other.quote: Together, the organizations are investing $1.8 billion in funding, data, computation, and new measurement technology, the largest coordinated commitment to generating AI-ready biological data to date.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 各組織合計投入 18 億美元於資金、資料、運算與新量測技術，是迄今產生 AI 可用生物資料最大規模的協調承諾。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral opens a public preview of Mistral Large 4, ‘Le Chonk’
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 公開預覽 Mistral Large 4「Le Chonk」
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral launched a public preview of Mistral Large 4 on Oct. 6: a natively multimodal model with 1 trillion parameters and about 49–52 billion active, trained from scratch on roughly 3,800–4,000 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPUs in its European data centers. Weights are not out; the company has said an open-weight drop is planned later in October.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 於 10 月 6 日公開預覽 Mistral Large 4：原生多模態、1 兆參數、約 490–520 億活躍參數，在歐洲資料中心約 3,800–4,000 顆 NVIDIA Grace Blackwell GPU 上從零訓練。權重尚未放出，公司稱計畫 10 月稍後開放。
frontier_other.analysis_en: The sovereignty pitch is concrete—European training and a promised open-weight drop—but the weights are not out, and several headline cyber scores reflect company-supplied evals rather than a settled independent ranking.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 主權論點具體：歐洲訓練與承諾的開放權重。但權重尚未釋出，多項資安分數來自公司提供的評測，不是已定案的獨立排名。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re launching a public preview of Mistral Large 4.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Mistral Large 4 的公開預覽。

brief_en: GPT-6 with Intelligent UI reaches ChatGPT Free and Go today on Luna, after paid tiers got Sol yesterday. Anthropic’s Haiku 5.5 and cheaper Sonnet cache reads are live. WSJ/Bloomberg report early Broadcom talks on $50B+ financing for OpenAI’s custom chip. Biohub’s $1.8B biology-data push and Mistral Large 4’s preview still stand.
brief_zh: GPT-6 智慧介面今日擴至免費與 Go（Luna）；付費層昨日已用 Sol。Anthropic 推出 Haiku 5.5 並降 Sonnet 快取讀取價。外媒稱博通正談逾 500 億美元融資、供 OpenAI 自研晶片。Biohub 18 億生物資料與 Mistral Large 4 預覽仍有效。
